fields.name: Wielder
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2EB3320 creates it (storage bg3.exe+0x2702660, size 0x18: null handle, 12 zero bytes) on the improvised weapon being put down (the key of a map whose entities have eoc::improvised_weapon::WieldedComponent) and writes the first qword of the 0x18-byte map value. bg3.exe+0x2EB2C70 fills that value as {wielder handle, wielder translation} (bg3.exe+0x127E500). Windows save loader bg3.exe+0x25CC740 (model ls::model::game::improvisedweapon::v1::SetPositionOneFrameComponent, 24 bytes, align 8; member names unknown) converts the model's EntityId at model +0 (FUN_144018730) and stores the 8-byte handle at component +0.

fields.name: Position
fields.evidence: Same place: 8+4 bytes of the map value (the wielder's position), replaced by the result of eoc::AiGrid::GetNearestSpiral when the weapon has bounds and a level - the position where the weapon is put. Windows save loader bg3.exe+0x25CC740 (model ls::model::game::improvisedweapon::v1::SetPositionOneFrameComponent, 24 bytes, align 8; member names unknown) converts the model's position at model +8 (FUN_142772030) and stores 12 bytes at component +8..+0x13; the creator in bg3.exe+0x2EB3320 writes 8 bytes at +8 and 4 at +0x10.

fields.name: _Pad14
fields.evidence: tail padding (size 0x18, 8-aligned by the handle); the loader writes the upper half of the qword at +0x10 from an uninitialised stack slot, the creator writes only the dword at +0x10
